content: शासन {%a.%} .²1 Teaching, instructing; इति मे न तु बोधाय कल्पते शासनं वचः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 8. 50</ls>. .²2 Punishing, chastising. .{@-नम्@} [शास्-ल्युट्] .²1 Instruction, teaching, discipline. .²2 Rule, sway, government; अनन्यशासनामुर्वीम् <ls>R. 1. 30</ls>; so अप्रतिशासन. .²3 An order, a command, direction; तरुभिरपि देवस्य शासनं प्रमाणीकृतम् <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 69</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 83</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 28</ls>. .²4 An edict, enactment, a decree. .²5 A precept, rule. .²6 A royal grant (of land <ab>&c.</ab>), charter; अहं त्वां शासनशतेन योजयिष्यामि <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 240</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">295</ls>. .²7 A deed, writing, written agreement; शासनप्रधाना हि राजानः स्युः <ls>Kau. A. 2. 9</ls>. .²8 Control of passions. .²9 A written book of authority. .²10 A (religious) doctrine. .²11 A message. (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab> शासन often means ‘punisher, destroyer, killer’; as in स्मरशासनः, पाकशासनः).
